hook: We opened a shop! You can't buy a dog in it.
sup: The Supporter Pack! A golden cottage, a name tag, and a thank-you letter from Gerald.
cozyb: The fireplace is cardboard. Don't tell anyone.
tools: And helpers! A Robo Scoop, a sprinkler, a water bowl. Switch them off any time.
trust: No loot boxes. Never dogs. Everything but the Supporter Pack can also be earned by playing.
end: Made by one person. Free to play. Thank you for helping!
